name: OKC_VARIABLES_INTERFACE
description: This is the interface table for import of user defined variables from external systems.  All valid data in this table will be imported to OKC_BUS_VARIABLES_A, OKC_BUS_VARIABLES_TL by  the XML Based Clause Import Concurrent program. The users are expected to upload data into this table using XML Schema. This is the open interface table for OKC Clause Library. Scope: public Lifecycle: active Display Name: OKC Clause Import Interface Product: OKC Category: BUSINESS_ENTITY OKC_LIBRARY_CLAUSE

columns.name: INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for each row. Users should use the sequence OKC_VARIABLES_INTERFACE_S.NEXTVAL to generate this identifier while loading data into this table.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: A system generated code or user entered number or code to identify a batch of rows in the interface table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: This is code that is used to identify the variable.

columns.name: VARIABLE_NAME
columns.description: This is the translatable name of the variable. The variable name enclosed in tags is embedded in the clause text.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This is a short description of the variable.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the imported Variable, as a result of the import process run in either 'Validation ' or 'Import' mode. Valid values are E - Error, W - Warning and S - Success. In 'Validation' mode, successful or records with Warnings will not have a status.Only records with errors will have a status of 'E'.  System Generated - Do Not Modify.

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: This column represents different options that can be performed while importing this Variable row. i.e. 'S' -  Sync the variable in the system.  'D' - Disable an existing Variable .

columns.name: VARIABLE_TYPE
columns.description: This defines the type of the variable. The valid values are S=System, U=User Defined, T=Table, D=Deliverable. For XML Based Clause Import , only U is supported.

columns.name: VARIABLE_INTENT
columns.description: This defines the  Intent of the variable i.e. Buy or Sell. Foreign Key to FND_LOOKUPS of lookup_type OKC_ARTICLE_INTENT.

columns.name: CONTRACT_EXPERT_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag to indicate whether this is being used in Contract Expert or not.

columns.name: XPRT_VALUE_SET_NAME
columns.description: Primary source for the contract expert enabled variable values

columns.name: DISABLED_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag to indicate whether this variable can no longer be used.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag to indicate whether this variable can be updated by external users or not e.g. supplier.

columns.name: VARIABLE_DATATYPE
columns.description: This is the Variable Datatype (D= Date, N=Number, V=Varchar2).

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: This column references the owning application in the case of system variables.  This is a foreign Key to FND_APPLICATION.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_NAME
columns.description: This defines the source of the user-defined variable value. This is mandatory for user-defined variables. Foreign Key to FND FLEX Value Sets.

columns.name: VARIABLE_DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: This is the Variable Datatype (D= Date, N=Number, V=Varchar2).

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: Any user defined code to indicate that this is imported from an external system. User can refer to the external system record with this code and the reference id columns. User FYI only.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: Id of the external system row being imported to the library. User can refer to the external system record with the Original System Code and the reference id columns.  User FYI only.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: Additional (composite) id of the external system row being imported to the library. User can refer to the external system record with the Original System Code and the reference id columns.  User FYI only.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
